written_before: the merge of agent/wiseman-pin-repair-20260921 (68730eab) and agent/deposit-mass-forensics-20260921 (5f54a161) into this branch, and before any re-derivation run, amendment write, or crosscheck run
class: rehearsal-2 top risk #1: repair lanes silently invalidate downstream receipt pins (text-clean, git-invisible; only the receipts' own hash checks catch it)
statement: The k-forensics and deposit-mass receipts pin tools/science_funnel/data/wiseman2026/** bytes as their worktrees held them: CRLF-smudged autocrlf=true checkouts of the LF-normalized acquisition blobs (instance-3 state). The wiseman pin-repair lane restored the pinned original bytes into the blobs AND put tools/science_funnel/data/wiseman2026/** under '-text -whitespace' (.gitattributes, 68730eab), so at integration the checked-out bytes become the raw blobs. Every enforced pin on a wiseman2026 text file whose pre-repair verification relied on the smudge, and every pin naming a file whose bytes the repair rewrote, now fails its own verification. The fix is append-only re-pins (amendments) naming old pin, new hash, cause, and a re-verification of every downstream number - plus a systemic crosscheck so the class is caught before merge.

prediction.P2_zero_delta: The repaired files' semantic content equals the consumed content: the manifest path->sha map (289 entries) changes in exactly 1 entry (inventory.json re-canonicalization, route b); the derivations' parsed inputs are byte-identical pre/post repair (Macaque_model.osim: the k lanes' measured d5c65cbc... IS the repaired raw blob; SI blobs untouched). Therefore after the append-only amendments both books regenerate byte-identical: k_forensics_book.json sha256 0c2d8b397a158283f19a8ff81a8f6be5f6a787ac09c09b7394c70e5402166b4b and deposit_mass_book.json sha256 6779e5dc48c8ab93c29a0cd01852b6a4fa5a3f41aee90397525a58732cc0a8d6; every k number (k=0.11975394 mtp / 0.11976026 ankle, femur 173.13 mm, tibia 156.81 mm) and every deposit number (0.772 kg pelvis+hindlimbs anomaly) is unchanged. DELTA EXPECTED: EXACTLY ZERO.
